qa: No, you reduce its memory cost by 3 based on the total number of Digimon and Tamer cards your opponent has in play. For example, if your opponent has 2 Digimon and 1 Tamer, this adds up to 3 cards total, which means you get to reduce the play cost by 9.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: When this card would be played, reduce the play cost by 3 for each of your opponent's Digimon and Tamers. [On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, delete all of their level 4 or lower Digimon. [End of Opponent’s Turn] [Once Per Turn] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
